# Xscriptor

Xscriptor sets EB Garamond typography with matching light and dark palettes for reading and writing. It adds subtle transparency and frosted-glass accents, improves code block readability, and exposes its styling options through Style Settings.

![Xscriptor screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xscriptor/obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Xscriptor"
    author: "xscriptor"
    repo:   "xscriptor/obsidian"
    slug:   "xscriptor"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/xscriptor"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/xscriptor/obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xscriptor/obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply EB Garamond typography with matching light and dark palettes for cleaner reading and writing. Add subtle transparency and frosted-glass accents, improve code block readability, and adjust styling via Style Settings."
}
```
